_about: W9 of the walls look (docs/design/walls-true-to-life.md 6.8): the words on the city's walls, in the 5x7 pixel font (game/scripts/pixel_font.gd), drawn into one atlas by game/scripts/wall_marks.gd. Polish only on the wall (UPPERCASE, correct diacritics); `en` is the gloss for the review (warsaw-tone skill: original, affectionate, invented, no real brand, club, firm, development, person or slur). `slogans`: one line each, at most 15 letters; `on` the looks rows whose walls may carry it (the palette's `marks.slogan.share` rows); `area` (optional) the name of a polygon in `areas` the slogan's wall must stand in (a district's name on its own walls). `banners`: developer hoarding banners, `lines` one to two lines of at most 11 letters, the invented developer's slogans; no real developer, brand or price. `areas`: polygons in map metres (x, z pairs, +x east, +z south), rough on purpose: `praga` the right bank east of the Vistula's right edge (the river's outline in centrum.json `areas`, water, every 200 m, extended north and south along its course); `wola` west of Aleja Jana Pawła II and north of Aleje Jerozolimskie (their centre lines in centrum.json `roads`); `bulwary` the left bank's strip along the river from north of the Old Town to the Łazienkowski bridge, from 300 m inland to 60 m out over the water's left edge (the river's outline every 200 m).

banners.en: APARTMENTS WITH A VIEW (of the next block)
